job_summary: A Veterinarian provides diagnostic, medical, and surgical services to animals, including analyzing animal conditions, developing treatment plans, communicating medical information to animal owners, and conducting health checks and routine surgeries.

hard_gates.requirement: At least 5 years of experience as a Veterinarian.
hard_gates.source_support: Job description Required Experience: Minimum of 5 years' experience as a Veterinarian.

hard_gates.requirement: Demonstrated ability in diagnosis and treatment planning.
hard_gates.source_support: Job description Required Skills: Diagnosis and Treatment Planning; responsibilities include analyzing animal conditions and formulating treatment plans. O*NET lists examining animals to determine diseases or injuries and developing medical treatment plans.

hard_gates.requirement: Demonstrated communication skills for clearly communicating medical information to animal owners.
hard_gates.source_support: Job description Required Skills: Communication Skills; responsibilities include communicating medical reports, advice, and instructions coherently to pet owners. O*NET lists advising animal owners and communicating health and wellness information.

soft_criteria.criterion: Ability to identify issues and implement efficient solutions when treating animals.
soft_criteria.why_relevant: The job description identifies problem-solving as a required skill, while O*NET identifies complex problem solving and making decisions and solving problems as relevant to veterinarians.

soft_criteria.criterion: Careful attention to accuracy when handling medical information, histories, examinations, and diagnostic results.
soft_criteria.why_relevant: The job description requires being detail oriented, and O*NET identifies documenting and recording information, analyzing medical data, and identifying information as relevant work activities.

soft_criteria.criterion: Demonstrated care and kindness toward animals and attention to their comfort and care.
soft_criteria.why_relevant: The job description requires compassion and a patient-focused mindset, while O*NET identifies assisting and caring for others and providing care for animals.

soft_criteria.criterion: Ability to analyze diagnostic information and use scientific information when making treatment decisions.
soft_criteria.why_relevant: O*NET identifies Biology, Medicine and Dentistry, and Science-related knowledge and skills, along with analyzing test data or images to inform diagnosis or treatment.

soft_profile.candidate_evidence: A treatment case reached a plausible approach, though adaptation to new evidence and practical constraints was uneven.
A record review overlooked conflicting history and examination details and carried an avoidable error into the diagnostic narrative.
An animal-handling simulation adjusted pace and restraint to distress signals while maintaining safe, calm, patient-focused care.
A diagnostic case integrated examination findings, test patterns, and scientific plausibility before selecting among competing explanations.
